name: BSquaredNetwork
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the DeFiHackLabs explorer label and description.
rootCause: Draining of 8.591M B2 tokens. Team estimated USD loss at approximately $3.86M USD (based on ransom demand: 10% of stolen funds = ~$386K USD). Attacker swapped stolen tokens to 1,128 ETH via WBNB intermediate and bridged out via NEAR Intents. Token price declined -15%. Attack Tx: https://bscscan.com/tx/0x29d3031a1d331cffdb1607153be9ee20adcad8c55d51bc32fc96c6f358cf5ea2 Source: https://twitter.com/DefimonAlerts/status/2080060105433682085
